value: This article presents the 50 most visited websites globally as of November 2020, drawing data from SimilarWeb, highlighting the overwhelming dominance of a few tech giants. Google, YouTube, and Facebook collectively receive more monthly visits than the remaining 47 websites combined. The analysis reveals the United States as the primary country of origin for most top sites, often owned by a handful of large corporations, while also noting the rise of platforms like Zoom and TikTok influenced by pandemic-era online migration. This accelerated market share growth, particularly among the top sites, raises questions about their continued expansion and increasing regulatory scrutiny.
